before.title: HVGERP Local Test Host
before.dom:
- heading "Host kiểm thử local HVGERP" [level=1]
- paragraph: Chỉ dùng fixture local. Không kết nối ERPNext hoặc đọc credential.
- text: Viewer
- combobox "Viewer":
  - option "invoice-viewer"
  - option "stock-viewer"
  - option "doclist-viewer" [selected]
  - option "chart-viewer"
  - option "kpi-viewer"
  - option "funnel-viewer"
  - option "kanban-viewer"
- text: Kịch bản
- combobox "Kịch bản":
  - option "smoke"
  - option "csv" [selected]
  - option "detail-race"
  - option "board-race"
  - option "initial-error"
  - option "refresh-error"
- text: Biểu đồ
- combobox "Biểu đồ":
  - option "bar" [selected]
  - option "horizontal-bar"
  - option "pie"
  - option "donut"
- button "Đặt lại"
- button "Gửi board B" [disabled]
- button "Gửi lại dữ liệu thành công"
- status: Đã kết nối
- iframe [id="viewer-frame"]:
  - generic: H
  - generic: Havi Group
  - generic: ERP · OPERATIONS
  - generic: Local CSV records
  - generic: 3 of 3 records
  - generic: Auto-refresh on focus
  - textbox "Search..."
  - button "Refresh":
    - text: Refresh
  - button "CSV":
    - text: CSV
  - table:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "name⇅ customer name⇅ amount⇅ notes⇅":
        - columnheader "name⇅"
        - columnheader "customer name⇅"
        - columnheader "amount⇅"
        - columnheader "notes⇅"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "CUSTOMER-001 Alpha, Incorporated 42 A \"quoted\" value":
        - cell "CUSTOMER-001":
          - generic: CUSTOMER-001
        - cell "Alpha, Incorporated":
          - generic: Alpha, Incorporated
        - cell "42":
          - generic: "42"
        - cell "A \"quoted\" value":
          - generic: A "quoted" value
      - row "CUSTOMER-002 =1+1 0 First line Second line":
        - cell "CUSTOMER-002":
          - generic: CUSTOMER-002
        - cell "=1+1":
          - generic: =1+1
        - cell "0":
          - generic: "0"
        - cell "First line Second line":
          - generic: First line Second line
      - row "CUSTOMER-003 Công ty Việt -1 +SUM(1,2)":
        - cell "CUSTOMER-003":
          - generic: CUSTOMER-003
        - cell "Công ty Việt":
          - generic: Công ty Việt
        - cell "-1":
          - generic: "-1"
        - cell "+SUM(1,2)":
          - generic: +SUM(1,2)
  - generic: Havi Group ERP
- heading "Yêu cầu đang giữ" [level=2]
- paragraph: Chọn đúng ID để trả kết quả theo thứ tự mong muốn. Viewer giữ timeout thật.
- list
- heading "Trace" [level=2]
- generic "Trace": "[ { \"outcome\": \"initialized\", \"viewer\": \"doclist-viewer\", \"scenario\": \"csv\" }, { \"outcome\": \"tool-input\" }, { \"outcome\": \"tool-result\", \"viewer\": \"doclist-viewer\" } ]"
